description: This file defines the Controller class for handling search settings within the SuiteCRM Administration module. It includes a constructor and a method to save search configuration based on POST data, supporting AJAX responses and redirection.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Handles actions related to search settings in the SuiteCRM Administration module, including saving configurations and responding to AJAX requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Controller object, calling the parent constructor with a View instance.

methods.name: doSave
methods.description: Processes POST data to update search engine settings, saves the configuration, handles AJAX responses, and redirects accordingly.
